string.text: Replaces New Game Randomize with a two-click D.O.G.M.A. button. PREP sets Story on, Warfare/Azazel/Soulslike off, Veteran + Survivalist, Ironman with 2 lives, and puts a 1911/SIG/cheapest pistol, ammo kit, 1 medkit, 2 yadylin, and a rebreather into the loadout. START begins the run (500 RU, that pistol at 59% parts, medkit set to 2 uses). If you change those settings, the button goes back to PREP. Faction, name, and spawn stay as you set them.
